links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no reading-level or audience instruction (no prompting), also compared with patient-friendly prompting and prompting for references
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of ChatGPT answers
links.effect: 8th-grade prompting mean grade level 13.43 ± 2.86 vs no prompting 14.97 ± 2.01 (p = 0.01) and prompting for references 16.43 ± 2.05 (p < 0.0001)
links.tradeoff: Even with 8th-grade prompting, output stayed well above recommended grade levels for patient information.
links.quote: Responses from 8th-grade level prompting were the lowest mean grade level (13.43 ± 2.86) and were significantly lower than no prompting (14.97 ± 2.01, p = 0.01) and prompting for references (16.43 ± 2.05, p < 0.0001).

links.comparator_used: Four prompt types were compared: no prompting, patient-friendly prompting, 8th-grade level prompting, and prompting for references.
links.outcome: Answer correctness and readability for thyroid-nodule patient education responses
links.effect: Proportions at least partially correct (p = 0.795) and correct (p = 0.402) did not differ by prompt; 8th-grade prompting had the lowest mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level, 13.43 ± 2.86, lower than no prompting 14.97 ± 2.01 (p = 0.01) and prompting for references 16.43 ± 2.05 (p < 0.0001).
links.tradeoff: Despite targeted prompting, responses remained above recommended patient-education reading levels.
links.quote: Responses from 8th-grade level prompting were the lowest mean grade level (13.43 ± 2.86) and were significantly lower than no prompting (14.97 ± 2.01, p = 0.01) and prompting for references (16.43 ± 2.05, p < 0.0001).
